trello.name: Integrate Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Owner: Alex, Jordan, Taylor. Deadline: Initial integration within two weeks, followed by one week of testing. Set up three subscription tiers (Basic: $29/month, Pro: $49/month, Enterprise: $99/month) in Stripe and integrate them into the app. Ensure tiers reflect correctly in functionality and user experience. Use Stripe Elements for the checkout process with a clean, straightforward design that includes a clear comparison of features, prominent checkout button, and tooltip explaining plan changes.

trello.name: Develop Frontend Checkout and Pricing Page
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within two weeks for initial integration. Implement Stripe Elements checkout form matching app design, handling errors like invalid card details or insufficient funds. Update pricing page to reflect new subscription tiers. Include user notifications for subscription confirmations and payment errors.

trello.name: Build User Dashboard Features
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Provide current plan details, billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscription, access to invoices and payment history, and payment method updates. Dashboard should be intuitive, reflect subscription status in real-time, and notify users of changes such as plan upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Implement Backend Stripe API Integration
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Within two weeks for initial integration. Integrate Stripe API to handle subscription creation, payment processing, and webhook management. Handle webhook events: invoice.payment_succeeded (activate subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users, send email notifications), customer.subscription.deleted (manage cancellations, update access, offer re-subscription). Ensure system updates correctly and test webhook handlers thoroughly with test scenarios.

trello.name: Integrate Frontend with Backend API
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Integrate frontend components with backend API after backend setup is complete. Ensure subscription changes are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Handle errors during integration with clear user notifications and instructions for resolving issues like payment failures.

trello.name: Prepare Comprehensive Testing Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Prepare and share a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow from signup to billing and subscription management. Include test scenarios for webhook events and edge cases to ensure full functionality.

trello.name: Create User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Owners: Alex, Jordan, Taylor. After launch, develop clear user instructions for managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and resolving common issues. Jordan to create help section or FAQ covering subscription questions. Taylor to document API endpoints and webhook handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting.

trello.name: Schedule Follow-up Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Schedule next meeting for the following week to review progress and address issues. Team members to report blockers or requests for help before then.
